tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bsnyen sgrub phrin las dang bcas pa'i yi ge dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra satwa sya sā dha naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan mkha' khyab dngos kun stong nyid rdo rje btsun mo'i 'jo sgeg dang*// yul can bde chen sems dpa' mnyam sbyor slob pa min pa'i zung 'jug ni// yan lag bdun gyi longs spyod chen pos rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sprin// spro dang sdud pa'i khyab bdag gcig pu dang po'i mgon des dge legs stsol// gang gi rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs// nye bar bsnyen las mchog thun gyi// dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i phyir// yi ge'i dpag bsam shing 'di 'khrungs// 'di la gsum/ bdag don bsnyen pa'i cho ga tshogs gsog sgrub pa'i cho ga gzhan don phrin las kyi cho ga'o// dang po la gnyis/ mngon rtogs spyir bstan pa dang*/ bsnyen thabs bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ nges 'byung dang byang chub sems gnyis kyis rgyud legs par sbyangs nas gzhan don kho nar myur ba myur bar thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i sgrub pa pos/ rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par mnos te dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas/ gnas dben par bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod/ dge sems khyad par can gyis mtshams sbyar nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor padma'i steng bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rin chen zhabs// shing rta chen po klu sgrub ma taṅgi// grub chen tai lo pa dang nā ro pa// mar pa lo tsā rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dbang gi rdo rje 'khon ston bsod nams zhabs// tshul khrims 'phags pa skyabs dang gzhon nu 'od// chos sku 'phags 'od bu ston rin chen grub// gzhon nu bsod nams rnams la=

/'jam mgon bla ma sher seng dpal ldan bzang*// dge 'dun 'phel ba bkra shis 'phags pa'i zhabs// bsam 'grub rgya mtsho brtson 'grus 'phags pa dang*// rdo rje bzang po rnams la= /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sde// dkon mchog yar 'phel ngag dbang chos ldan dpal// blo bzang chos 'dzin bstan pa'i sgron me dang*// ngag dbang chos grags rnams la= /ngag dbang phrin las dge legs chos 'phel zhabs// ye shes skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*// skyabs kun 'dus zhal dpal ldan rdo rje sems// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bdag ni sngon chad nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i las// bgyis dang bgyid stsal rjes su yi rang ba// bsam pa thag pas mgon po rnams la bshags// dngos dang brgyud pa'i rje btsun bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rim gnyis zab mo'i gru chen nang zhugs nas// kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs// snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs// rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi// bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*// sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi// dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// 'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing*// snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan// rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa// brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas// sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin// lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi// sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi// zhes skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ yab rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang yum padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drang*/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa nas/ shabda pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drang*/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā zhes mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rdo rje sems dpa' sprul sku'i rnam pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ spro na/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing bstod pa'i mos pas/

oṃ badzra satwa arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣyo me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor bar gsal gdab/ de'i tshe/ thugs ka'i yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas yig 'bru la thim pas yig 'bru las bdud rtsi dkar po byung*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs kyis thon/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dkar mer gyis khengs/ rtogs pa'i yon tan bdag gzhan thams cad la skyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya nas/ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/

ces ci nus su bzla/ mthar thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag go zhes gsungs nas rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur par bsams pa'i ngang nas/ padma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po ston ka'i zla ba dri ma med pa'i mdangs lta bu/ zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ yab rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang*/ yum padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drang*/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa nas/ shabda pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pa nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā zhes mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rdo rje sems dpa' sprul sku'i rnam pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ spro na rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing bstod pa'i mos pas/ oṃ badzra satwa arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje sems dpa' la phyal 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas gzi brjid dang*/ mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣyo me bha wa/ su poṣyo me wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ

bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor bar gsal btab la bzlas pa ci nus su bya/ thun bsdu ba na thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab cing sdig sgrib dag pa'i nges shes bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te snod bcud thams cad la phog de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar du rim gyis thim ste/ de'ang mi dmigs par gyur par bsams la/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag slar yang stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs bkra shis brjod cing thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /thun mtshams su gtor 'bul/ spro na/ 'bul gtor zlum po mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ oṃ āḥbighān ta kṛ ta hūm̐ gis bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ bhrūm̐ oṃ dzriṃ kham̐ rnams las byung ba'i sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/

slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i nang du rdo rje gsum rim gyis zhu zhing thim pas kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs shing zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mang por sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min gyi zhing nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa bdun gyis dbul/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ yig brgya bzlas te/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces dmigs/ gnyis pa bsnyen thabs bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rgyud sde'i spyi'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gnad longs shing phyag len shes pa zhig gi dbang du byas te 'dir mdor bsdu na/ sngon du gsang 'dus bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bsnyen pa thon yon na legs/ med na bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sgom bzlas dang sngags ring thung gang rung nyin gsum tsam gtong rgyu sgrub pa dngos gzhi bar chad sel ba la bsngags/

zla ba yar ngo'i tshes gcig la sogs pa'i tshes grangs dang gza' skar bzang po'i nyin yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rdo rje sems dpa'i bris 'bur gyi sku la sogs pa rten dang mchod pa legs par bsham/ mtshams ma grol ring la bya byed sogs rnam g.yeng chen po mi 'ong ba dang*/ mtshams g.yog 'jog 'os sogs sta gon byas te/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa legs par phul/ bgegs gtor btang la nag phyogs pa rnams bskrad/ bsang dang cha gsum sogs btang ste dkar phyogs pa rnams la mtshams kyi ring la bar chad zlog pa'i phrin las bcol/ mtshams tho bslang*/ srod kyi dus su kha shar du phyogs pa'am phyogs par mos pas/ stan bde ba la 'khod de/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis dbyer med pa skyabs yul gyi gtso bo dang*/ mtha' skor du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs sprin gyi phung po 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i skyabs yul gsal btab la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams yid 'khul nges pa sngon du btang*/ de nas sgrub thabs ltar rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ lha sku'i gsal snang re re bzhin bton la yun ring du sems gzung*/ nga rgyal yang nas yang du brtan cing dag dran rgyas par shes na dang*/ mi nus na/ chos sku spros pa dang bral ba las gzugs sku snang stong me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu gang 'dul gyi rol pa brda dang rtags kyi rnam par shar bar mos te/ ji skad du/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis// sgyu ma'i sku ni mtshon par bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla bas so// zhes pa ni bskyed rim bsgom pa'i gnad kyi snying po'o// de la gsal snang brtan nas bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ thog mar bgrang phreng zhi ba gtsor byed na dung ngam shel dkar/ mchog la bo dhi tsi'i phreng ba blangs la byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/

bzlas pa'i gzhi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du sbrul 'khyil ba ltar bsams la yig 'bru re re nas gsal btab ste rags pa'am sgom lo tsam gyi dbang du ma shor bar yid gzhan du mi yengs par rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis yig gzugs dang sgra gdangs la sems gtad/ shes shing spro na yi ge brgya pa'i nges don thugs rgyud skul ba'i rgyu mtshan kyang dran par bya/ skabs su lha rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa dang sngags yig brgya bzlas pa'i phan yon la nges shes bskyed/ rnam pa kun tu 'khor ba la nges 'byung*/ sems can la snying rje/ bla ma lha la mos gus kyi rtsal yang yang bskyar bas rang rgyud la de dag gi ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan cung zad skyes na rgyud rnam par dag cing lha bsgoms pa dang sngags bzlas pa rnams kyi 'bras bu myur du 'byin par 'gyur ro// bzlas pa 'jog pa'i thun mthar dbyangs gsal dang rten snying*/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ gsang ba spyi ltar stong tshigs kyi mchod bstod byas kyang legs pa'i yan lag go /bsdu rim byas la mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam gzhag ci nus bya/ slar thun mtshams kyi lha sku snang stong zung 'jug tu ldangs la gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam thun mong ma yin pa gdab/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral bas spyod lam thams cad dran shes kyi rtsis zin par byas la lam du khyer/ thun bzhi ka'am ma lcogs na dgong thun gyi gsham gtor ma 'bul zhing gzhan chos skyong gtor 'bul sogs kyang ma chag pa bya/ thun mtshams su'ang yid kyi rnam g.yeng dang ngag gi long gtam spangs la grangs su mi brtsi bar yi ge brgya pa shub bur bzla ba rgyun mi bcad/

nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar ngag byin rlabs dang bdud rtsi myong ba rnams kyang bla med spyi 'gro ltar bya/ dbang rab la mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni rtags rab 'bring tha ma gang rung mthong ba dang*/ dbang 'bring la dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gsum mam drug dbang po tha mas grangs kyi bsnyen pa rab bye ba/ 'bring 'bum phrag bdun/ tha mas 'bum phrag bzhi bzla/ kha skong sbyin sreg byed na sdig sbyong til la grangs gzung ba dang*/ bzlas pas kha skong na'ang bsnyen pa gang song gi bcu cha ste 'bum phrag bzhi la khri phrag bzhis kha skong dgos pas mtshon no// bsnyen pa grub nas sgrub mchod byed na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ zhag bdun la sogs par sgrub cing snga dro'i char dngos grub kyi don du rjes gnang gtor dbang dang bcas pas bdag 'jug blangs la rjes kyi bya ba rnams mtha' rgyas su bya'o// rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan thos pa dang sku'i rnam pa bsgoms pa dang yig brgya bzlas pa'i phan yon mtha' yas pa rgyud sde gong 'og kun nas 'byung zhing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dpal de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu dang po las/ de nas phyag rgya thams cad kyi spyi'i rang gi lus dang ngag sems rdo rjer bya ba'i spyi'i cho ga rgyas pa bshad de/ nam phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs lhod par gyur tam/ bdag gtong bar 'dod na/ de nas snying po 'dis brtan par bya'o// oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya gsungs pa'i mthar/ des ni mtshams med pa byas pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bslus pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos la smod pa dang*/ nyes pa thams cad byas pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya sgrub pa pos rdo rje sems dpa' brtan par 'gyur bas/ tshe 'di nyid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad dang*/ dngos grub mchog gam/ rdo rje'i dngos grub grub pa'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub bam/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub kyi bar du myur du 'grub bo zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so// zhes bka' stsal to// zhes dang snying po rgyan las kyang ched du bsngags pas/ 'bum phrag tu ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// ces pas stobs bzhi tshang zhing bskyed bzlas tshul bzhin grub na 'bum phrag gcig gis dam tshig nyams chags kyi ltung ba thams cad byang bar 'gyur la/ de'ang deng sang dus dbang gis bzhi 'gyur ni nges par dgos par gsal/ yang*/ rab tu bag med par gnas na// nyes pa chung ngu phra mo yang*// sbrul gyi mche bas btab bzhin du// lus ngag sems las nyams par byed// ces gsungs pa ltar sbrul gdug pa can gyi sos btab pa'i de ma thag dug zhi ba'i sman sngags ma byas na skrangs pa dang na tsha rim gyis 'phel te srog 'dor ba'i nyes pa skyed pa bzhin du/ nyes ltung phra mo rnams kyang de ma thag ma sbyangs na zhag lon nas rim gyis 'phel te 'phral du nad gdon bgegs kyis 'tshe ba sogs sdug bsngal skyed cing phyi ma ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur bas/ dus rgyun du thun mjug gam thun mtshams nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na ltung ba byin gyis brlabs nas 'phel bar mi 'gyur bar gsungs pas sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis 'di nyid la g.yar dam du 'cha' bar rigs so// gnyis pa tshogs gsog sgrub pa'i cho ga la gsum/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ ril bu bsgrub tshul lo// dang po ni/ rten gyi spyan sngar stegs gtsang ma'i dbus su maṇḍal la rdul tshon gyis padma 'dab brgyad dkar po bris pa'i steng du khri'u khar rin po che'i snod du zlum gtor dkar po padma 'dab bzhis spras pa rgyan spros can bum chog sogs dang sbrel na g.yas g.yon du de dag gi chas sgrig mdun du 'bul gtor dkar zlum dang*/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi/

chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor du bsham/ sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs pas mdun du rdor dril nang mchod sogs tshogs par byas la/ thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang skyabs sems bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud par gyur/ bsang sbyang nas gong du smos pa'i gtor ma'i skabs ltar nang mchod byin brlab/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las mchod rdzas rnams rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis brlab/ de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa gsol gdab kyi bar btang la/ mdun rten bsang sbyang*/ bdag bskyed skabs ltar la rang nyid ces pa dor/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur bar/ de nas mchod pa la phyi mchod ni/ dag cing dri ma med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin mdzod// oṃ āḥhrīḥpra bar satkā ra arthaṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ mchod yon dang*/ arghaṃ zhes pa'i mal du/ zhabs bsil/ pā dyaṃ zhes bsgyur/ oṃ lha yi me tog dam pa ni// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal// thugs ni rtse bar nyer dgongs te// mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ āḥbadzra satwa puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ des 'gres te/ me tog gi gnas su bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang*/ puṣpaṃ gyi gnas su/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shabda sbyar/ 'dod yon ni/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos rdo rje sems la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra satwa pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/

gos zung ni/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐/ rgyal srid ni/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir// nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul// oṃ badzra satwa sapta ratna pra tītstsha swā hā/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal du= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal= dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi zhal= dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal= dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dge bsnyen rnams kyi zhal= sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim par gyur cig ces thigs gtor bya/ gsang mchod ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ de kho na nyid ni/ dbang po gang dang gang lam gyis// sgrub pa pos ni yul thob pa// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje// mnyes pa'i phyir ni dbul bar bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ bstod pa ni/ rdor sems kyi bstod pa gang rung brjod kyang legs la 'dir bde gshegs spyi bstod ni/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams// sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yis// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur// e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgya che ste// lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// bzlas pa bya ba ni/

gsol gdab nas sa bon sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu sogs bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ yig brgya ji tsam nus pa bzla/ thun mthar gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhig dag par gyur ces gnang ba stsal bar mos/ gong du bshad pa ltar gtor ma byin brlab/ mdun bskyed kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos byin brlab/ sngags tsam gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes mang du brjod nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas nongs pa bshags shing lhag chad kha bskang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ rten yod na ye shes pa brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/

badzra muḥs rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs kyis bdag bskyed nyer bsdu nas bkra shis bar bya'o// gnyis pa bum pa sgrub na/ maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad steng bum pa mgul chings prog gsum ldan gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ dri bzang gi chu dang bla med bum rdzas so lngas sum gnyis bkang ba kha rgyan bcas dang dung chos gzungs rdor bkod/ las bum mchod gtor/ nang mchod/ phyi mchod kyis bskor/ 'di nyid sger du sgrub na brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems/ bdud rtsi dang mchod pa byin rlabs nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas sngon du gtang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang sbrel na mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa gsol gdab bcas grub nas/ las bum du skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la bgegs mthar byed nag po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing dril bu dgra st+wa 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i nyams dang 'gyur ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul rigs lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can tu gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi gdan la hūm̐ yig mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa tsam bzlas mthar/ lha 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ rnam bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ tapte tapte mahā tapte swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las sogs mdun bskyed ltar la/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes rang bzhin las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo mchod yon ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha mchog mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ bha ga wān shrī badzra satwa arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur bas mchod/ de las kyang rgyas par mos na 'dod yon lnga dang*/ rgyal srid bdun sogs spyi ltar 'bul/ bstod pa rgyas pa gzhan nam/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs sangs rgyas spyi'i bstod pas bstod/ bsdu na/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs brjod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas/ mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur// ces pa'i bar brjod la yig brgya cung zad bzla/ gzungs thag blangs la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐ lan bdun dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i sa bon las lha'i tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can du gyur par bsams la yig brgya ci nus dang*/ oṃ badzra a da ka hūm̐ zhes pa'ang brgya rtsa bzla/ mthar oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ dang*/ hūm̐ lan bdun gyis dung chu'i mchod yon dang*/ las sngags kyi me tog dkar po phul/ oṃ badzra satwa puṣpe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐ dang*/ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/

dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shabda zhes sbyar bas mchod/ las sngags brjod cing spos kyis bdug gtor ma gong ltar 'bul/ mchod bstod bya/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// sogs dang yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas nongs pa bshags shing lhag chad kha bskang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ bum pa'i lha chags pa chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa bkru byab srung gsum dang*/ sbyong chog sogs byed na spyi ltar lha sngags kha bsgyur te 'dir bya/ mjug tu bdag bskyed nyer bsdu sogs gong ltar bya'o// gsum pa ril bu sgrub pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang skye bdun sha gtso bor gyur pa'i 'phags bod kyi byin rten sel med khungs btsun rnams dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga gtsos bzang sman rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu lha mdog dang mthun pa'i dkar po'am yul lugs dang sbyar ba'i rtsi dang ril chags legs par byas/ bum pa dar sna lnga'i mgul chings can brab bdug byas pa'i nang du blugs te maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bkod pa'i khar gzungs thag me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa bzhag mchod gtor sogs mdun bskyed ltar bkod/ brgyud 'debs dang*/ skyabs sems/ bdud rtsi dang mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa gsol gdab yan grub nas/ ril bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba sogs mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ril bu rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa sogs bdag bskyed ltar lha bskyed/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan cing dbang lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod bstod rgyas par spro na mdun bskyed ltar dang*/

bsdu na bum bskyed ltar bya/ gzungs thag blangs la/ ril bu lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sogs bum sgrub skabs ltar la mdzad pa can du gyur/ ces dmigs la yig brgya bzla/ 'di nas brtsams sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar sgrub grogs gzhan dang bcas sngags rgyun ma chad par bya/ thun mthar gtor 'bul/ mchod bstod/ gzod gsol/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ brtan bzhugs/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu sogs nas bkra shis bar gong ltar dang*/ skabs skabs su khrus gsol kyang bya/ grol rgyu'i thun tha ma la 'dod gsol rjes su/ ril bu'i ye shes pa chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba las sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i ril bu'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ rten 'brel snying pos brtan par bya/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu nas bkra shis bar rgyas par bya'o// gsum pa gzhan don phrin las kyi cho ga la bzhi/ rjes gnang*/ rab gnas/ sbyong chog sbyin sreg rnams so// dang po slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ gshom bkod mdun bskyed skabs su smos pa ltar bya/ thog mar bdag bskyed bzlas pa gsol gdab bcas grub nas las bum du bgegs mthar byed bskyed bzlas bum sgrub skabs ltar bya/ gong du ma song na bdud rtsi dang mchod pa byin brlab/ rten gtor bsang sbyang*/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan ces pa'i bar gong ltar bskyed/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mdun bskyed kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ slob ma rnams khrus byas la gral du 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la chos bshad ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ 'dir skabs su bab pa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa'i snying po rgyan las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig po// pad dkar zla ba'i dbus gnas shing*// rdo rje dril bu rgyan spras pa'i// rdo rje sems dpa' legs dmigs shing*// yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin// nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas// ltung sogs byin gyis brlab 'gyur bas// 'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes// grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas// thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya// 'bum phrag tu ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag mtshan thos pa dang sku sgom pa dang snying po bzlas pa tsam gyi thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dang*/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsad nas byang zhing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi skye sgo gcod par mdzad pa la lhag pa'i lha kun las khyad par 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs rgyud sde gong 'og kun nas rgya cher gsungs pa las/ 'dir dpal nā ro pa dang ye shes snying po las lho brag mar pa lo tsās gsan pa'i 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi gdams pa las byung ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes dang byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par bgyi ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rjes gnang gsan pa'i yon du zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/

zhes brda sbyar la maṇḍal 'bul gzhug thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnams sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sprin phung ltar gtibs te bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi skyabs su mchi ba dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i yid rtse gcig pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de nas khyad par gyi gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo slob dpon rin po che bdag la dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar sgoms mdzod/ las bum gyi chu 'thor la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pam̐ las padma dang sogs bdag bskyed mngon rtogs ltar la/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi rdor sems yab yum khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon par mos shig ces gsal gdab/ spyi bor bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po'i mthar yig brgya'i sngags phreng dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po'i mthar yig brgya'i sngags phreng dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar yig brgya'i sngags phreng sngon po rnams kyis bskor ba gsal thob cig de nas byin rlabs dngos la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod cig rdo rje sems dpa'i spyi bo'i oṃ dang yig brgya dkar po las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ slob ma'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad dang*/ khyad par spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor khengs/ thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad dag sku'i byin rlabs dang bum pa'i dbang thob par mos su bcug la/ yig brgya lan gcig brjod/ des 'gres te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mgrin pa'i āḥdang yig brgya dmar po las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ mgrin pa'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ slob ma'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad dang*/ khyad par mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor khengs/ thog med nas ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad dag gsung gi byin rlabs dang gsang ba'i dbang thob par mos shig yig brgya brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang yig brgya sngon po las 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi sngon po rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ slob ma'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad dang*/ khyad par snying ga'i rtsa 'khor khengs/ thog med nas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad dag thugs kyi byin rlabs dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par mos shig

yig brgya brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum dang sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tshogs 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ slob ma'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi rtsa 'khor thams cad gang*/ thog med nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang dbang bzhi pa thob par mos shig yig brgya brjod do// de nas gtor ma'i byin rlabs bya ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dngos su gsal ba spyi bor spyan drangs pa'i sku las 'od zer dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung*/ khyad par rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshigs nyams chags su gyur pa thams cad byang zhing dag sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs ma lus pa thob par mos shig rten gtor mgor bzhag la/ bka' bsgo spyi mthun brjod kyang chog la/ yang na/ bcom ldan 'di la byin lags kyis// rdo rje sems dpas byin gyis rlobs// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// rdor sems go 'phang ma thob bar// lhag pa'i lha ru zhugs nas kyang*// rtag par byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// da lta nyid du stsal du gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/ gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim par mos shig

ces sam/ gtor ma'i lha las ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa 'phros khyed rnams la thim par mos shig ces gang 'os bya/ bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros te slob ma'i khar zhugs/ thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas yig 'bru la thim pas/ yig 'bru las bdud rtsi dkar po byung*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs kyis thon/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dkar mer gyis gang*/ rtogs pa'i yon tan bdag gzhan thams cad la skyes par mos la sngags kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la sogs kyis slob dpon la me tog phul ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// me tog slar sbyin pa spyi ltar bya/ dam tshig gzung ba/ gtang rag maṇḍal/ lus 'bul dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar bya/ de rjes mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ mchod bstod nongs bshags gsol gdab bcas kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs nyer bsdu nas bkra shis kyi bar gong ltar bya/ gtor ma'i lha rdzogs par slob ma la bstims zin na mdun bskyed med pas bdag bskyed nyer bsdu man chad byas pas grub bo// gnyis pa rten la rab gnas bya ba ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las 'dir nyer mkho lag tu len bde ba bsdus pa'i dbang du byas te/ rgyas pa paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa sogs dang*/ bsdus pa lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis mdzad pa sogs las rtogs par bya ba kho na yin zhing*/

'dir 'bring po'i phyag len bu ston dang rje rin po che'i bzhed pa ltar 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gsal bar mdzad pa ltar lag tu blang bde bar bkod pa la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po dang 'brel na de'i dkyil 'khor dbang skur gyi chas sogs rdzogs par 'god dgos kyang*/ 'dir rdor sems gtso rkyang la brten pa'i dbang du byas te de'i mdun rten sgrub mchod skabs su smos pa ltar bsham/ rab gnas kyi khrus kyi stegs bu'i steng du padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su rnam rgyal dang las bum/ mdun ngos su khrus bum gcig bkod/ rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis nang bcud sogs spyi mthun dang*/ khrus bum nang du mngar gsum zho 'bras bu 'bru 'bras yos sman sna rin po che rnams chu gtsang dang sbyar bas bkang*/ mdun du dung phor nya phyis la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar 'dag chal bdud rtsi lnga ba byung lnga dri bzang lnga skyu ru ra'i phye ma sbyar ba dang*/ sku byug rdzas dri zhim po'i 'bru mar/ spos mar/ dri bzang lde gu/ 'bru mar rnams dang*/ dril phyis rdzas 'o ma can bal bu sogs kyi shun pa/ yung ba/ skyu ru ra/ sran dkar gyi phye ma ste tsho gsum po thams cad 'dzoms na dang*/ ma 'dzoms na gang rnyed lhan cig tu sbyar ba/ dūrba'i pir/ me long*/ dri bzang phye ma/ rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pa'i dar dkar/ gos zung rnams bzhag chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar du dgod/ stegs gzhan du mnga' dbul chas maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun bkod pa/ dar sna lnga/ dar ras ngur smig rin po che'i rgyan cha/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ lnga phrag lnga'i rdzas/ gdugs 'phan bla re sogs dngos sam ri mor bris pa/ lha bshos che legs rgyan ldan dkar mngar shing tog sogs bza' btung gis bskor ba/ 'thor nas 'bru dkar gtsang ma rnams dgod/ sngon 'gro dkar gtor/ sbyong ba zhi drag

gu gul/ yungs kar/ slob dpon gyi mdun chas sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par bya/ spros pa rgyas shing 'dzoms na 'thor nas kyi steng du me long la tsandan dkar dmar gi waṃ gur gum rnams sbyar bas dbus su hūm̐/ mtha' skor du ye dhar bris pa bzhag bsdu na mi dgos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma rang rang gi cho ga las 'byung ba'am/ 'dir spyi tsam du/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag sogs kyis longs spyad pas tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tata khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes pa gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ sogs nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang*// gang yang sa la brten pa rnams// sems can rnams la dge don du// byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol la gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ mchod pa byin rlabs sgrub thabs so so ltar ram/ spyi tsam du bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par bsam/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ badzra puṣpe/ badzra dhū pe/ badzra ā lo ke/ badzra gandhe/ badzra nai wi dya/ badzra shabda'i bar rnams bcug la byin gyis brlab/ de nas skyabs sems nas brtsams/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa btang*/ de nas bum pa bsgrub cing bzlas dmigs skabs/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pas 'jig rten khams kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur/ ces mos/ bum lha 'od zhu'i rjes la bum bsgrub/ 'dag rdzas dang khrus bum rnams kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyi bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams dang*/ mdor na snod bcud kyi yon tan thams cad bkug nas sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dag byed kyi rdzas rnams byin gyis rlob par bsams te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ tri ma dhu sna da bū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ thog mtha' sbyar te/ oṃ da dhwi/ pha la/ bru hi/ gandhe/ labdza/ o ṣa dhi/ ma ṇi re re'i mthar sna na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa re re dang*/ thun mong du oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te zhes sogs dang*/ rten 'brel snying po'ang nyer gcig tsam bzla/ de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor skabs ltar bsgrub/ bzlas pa gtor 'bul bcas rgyas pa dang*/ me long bris pa yod na de steng dang med na 'bru dkar gyi steng du rten snying gi yi ge rnams gyen du 'greng zhing gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis srid pa dang zhi ba'i yon tan thams cad dang*/

rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad spyan drangs te sngags phreng me tog dang bcas par thim par bsams la/ ye dhar brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te yi ge rnams bzhus pa'i dri bzang gi chus me tog khyab par bya ste me tog gam 'thor nas bsgrub pa'o// sdom tshig tu 'dir rten bskyed pa dang*/ dkyus su khrus kyi rjes su gsol gdab dang rten bskyed 'dam gar gsungs pa phyi ma phyag len bde bas de ltar na bgegs sbyang ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs su 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol// badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod kyang phul/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngams stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/

'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// sbyong gtor rnams sngon 'gro ltar byin brlab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bkug par gyur/ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tata khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na ba liṃ ta ye swā hā lan gsum bsngos la zhi bas sbyang*/ ting lo changs bu mtheb kyu dang bcas pas phyir bskor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐/ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dzā hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum ste zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ hūm̐ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir rab gnas cho ga byed// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad kyi bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas rang rang gi gnas su song zhig

gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// sumbha ni drag tu brjod/ gtor ma rnams rten la phyir bskor te dor/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyi brab/ rol mo'i tsham rngams kyis sbyang ba ni drag pos sbyong ba'o// khrus gsol ba'i thog mar snyan gsan ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa de dag thams cad la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o// de nas thog mar dri ma bkru ba'i phal khrus ni/ me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba la 'dag chal rnams nyug nas/ gtsang zhing dri ma mi mnga' yang*// dag byed bzang po lnga rnams ni// legs par sbyar ba'i byug pa 'di// yongs su dag par bya phyir 'bul// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes brjod/ de la dūrba'i pir gyis drud cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na swā hā/ zhes nyed pa'i tshul bya'o// de nas khrus bum thogs la/ rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing*// rme ba'i rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// sri zhu'i tshul gyis khrus chab 'dis// bde gshegs rnams la sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ sku byug rnams kyis byug pa'i tshul byas la/ mi phyed rdo rje'i sku nyid la// bsnyun med bsgres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'jig rten gus pa'i tshul tsam du// dri zhim bku mnye 'di rnams kyis// dri zhim byug pa'i rim gro bgyi// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī.āḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dūrba'i pir gyis drud/ dril phyis rnams 'debs la/ rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// 'od gsal rnyog pa mi mnga' yang*// dril phyis phye ma 'di rnams kyis// sku ni rab tu dril zhing phyi// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdūrba'i pir gyis drud cing*/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ de nas mchog khrus gsol la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas spyan drangs pa'i rnam snang sogs sangs rgyas yab yum gyis khrus gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha gzhan rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis mchod par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje// ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po de// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// zhes pa'i glu sngon du btang*/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der// ces khrus khang bskyed/ 'dag chal 'bul ba ni/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes brjod cing*/ dri bzang gi lde gu byugs/ dūrba'i pir gyis drud cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ rnam bum gyis khrus gsol la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ sngags 'di gnyis 'og ma rnams su'ang sbyar ro// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol// sngags gong ltar brjod/ khyod ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs gos pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// khyod ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// tshul khrims dri yis legs gos pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// khyod ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// zhe sdang dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// byams pa dri yis legs gos pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// khyod ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// brtson 'grus dri yis legs gos pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// khyod ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// ting 'dzin dri yis legs gos pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// khyod ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// ye shes dri yis legs gos pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// chu bo drug gis khrus byas shing*// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sngags brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/

mi phyed rdo rje'i sku nyid la// bsnyun med bgres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'jig rten gus pa'i tshul tsam du// dri zhim byug pa'i rim gro bgyi// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes brjod cing 'bru mar dri zhim pos byug dūrba'i pir gyis bdal zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// 'od gsal rnyogs pa mi mnga' yang*// dri bzang lnga yi phye ma yis// rgyal ba'i sku la dril phyis bya// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes brjod cing*/ dri bzang gi phye ma 'debs/ dūrba'i pir gyis drud cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ dar dkar gyis sku phyi ba'i tshul gyis/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku dbyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dri bzang pos byug sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba// gong bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wast+ra ye āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro ba kun// mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ ratna a laṅka ra pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes rgyan 'bul yang spro na bya'o// de nas gsol ba gdab cing sems bskyed pa ni/ bzhengs te me tog thogs/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas 'di ltar brjod de/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/

rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// mdor bsdu na de tsam bya/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyis chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang*/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/ de yi nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// 'bring 'dod na 'di tsam bya/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa/ cho 'phrul gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de yi yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pa/ nyos mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang*/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// zhes brjod cing*/

rab tu gnas bya la me tog 'thor/ spos kyi bdug cing rol mo dkrol la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya arha te saṃ mya ksaṃ buddhaya/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha'i sngags dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ zhes bzhi ga'i mthar brjod do// sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bskyed la 'di ltar/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// de dag thams cad bdag la dgos su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi pas/ de'i mthus bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo*// 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o// phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o// sems can rnams kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o// sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o// sems can rnams kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do// 'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye ma brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o// ma dad pa dang*/ phyi rol pa dag dang*/ lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro// las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o// srid pa'i rgya mtsho bskam par bgyi'o// chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o// byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o// bzod pa dang nges pa la gzud do// bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rtser stsal to// 'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o// zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o// bden pa la gzud do// phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o// ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o// sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o// 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang*/

bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'dug cing gnas par bgyi'o// de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol cing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ ces 'dus pa chen po'i mdo las 'byung ba ltar sems bskyed cing me tog gtor ro// 'di yang bsdu na/ sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo*// zhes pa nas/ sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o// 'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o// de bas na zhes sogs sbrel lo// de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ rgyas par na gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten rnams rnam snang*/ gsung rab rnams 'od dpag med/ phyag mtshan rdo rje la sogs pa mi bskyod pa sogs so sor bskyed pa'am/ bsdu na thams cad dkyil 'khor gang la brten pa'i gtso bor bskyed pa cho ga la 'dir mtshon na/ bdag bskyed ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du bskyed/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur par bsam/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar byas pa lag ngar gnyis bsnol te gung mo dang mtheb mo gnyis kyis se gol rdeb pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ces pa tsam mam/ rgyas par na/ bcom ldan bskal pa sogs nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// ces pa'i bar brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/

rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams kyi ye shes pa dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kri ta hūm̐ zhes rang gi las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis ye shes pa'i phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis sngar bzhin chu gnyis nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing*/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so so dang dbyer med par gyur par bsam/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gshegs pa dang gshegs ma dang*/ sems dpa' dang sems ma dang khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar pos dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur par bsam/ sngar bzhin chu gnyis nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces sam/ rigs gsum sogs bskyed yod na dbu rgyan sogs rigs so so ltar bya/ de nas spyan dbye ba ni/ gser gyi thur mas dngul gyi kong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres pa thur ma'i rtse mos blangs te lugs ma la sogs pa'i spyan dang*/ gzhan rnams me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i spyan la byug cing*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// rgyal ba rnams kyis khyod kyi ni// mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal// oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/

kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /ces brjod cing spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i don du/ yon bdag la sogs pa la gzigs pa lhur mdzad par gyur/ de nas mchod pa gsar du rgya cher bsham pa'am/ kha gsos la bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes te bdag la bka' drin stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du yon chab ces pa'i gnas su pā dyaṃ zhes pa bcug la zhabs bsil dang*/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes// puṣpe/ zhes me tog lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// dhū pe/ zhes bdug spos/ mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di// kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// ā lo ke/ zhes snang gsal/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni// rang byung nyid la 'bul bar bgyi// kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol// gandhe/ zhes dri/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pas// bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul// nai wi dya/ zhes zhal zas/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston cing*// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra// bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi// don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig

/shabda/ zhes rol mo dbul/ de nas rab tu gnas bya'i lha so so'i sgos bstod shes na des bstod la/ mi spro na/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje bdag nyid khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos padma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bcug nas// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyod la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor nub gyur rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes spyi bstod bya/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba ni/ lha rang rang gi sngags brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pa/ spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka gsum du reg pas/ bskyed pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i rnam pa 'khor ba ji srid du 'gro ba'i don bya ba'i byin nus dang ldan par rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces bsgom/ rgyas par spro na mchod bstod bya/ de nas mnga' dbul ba ni/ maṇḍal phul la/ sa gzhi spos kyi byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog

/oṃ badzra su re khe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ las bum gyis khrus gsol la/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ na bza' sna tshogs phul la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ mi phyed dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /rab byung rnams la ngur smrig phul la/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba yis// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra wa sa sye āḥhūm̐/ longs sku la rin po che'i rgyan cha phul la/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis// mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badzra ā laṃ ka ra wa pu ṣa ṇi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ 'dod yon lnga phul la/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la dbang bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra sa manta bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal srid phul la/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sapta mahā ratna pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lnga phrag lnga phul la/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la// lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul// 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog

/oṃ badzra pañtsi bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gdugs sogs phul la/ brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*// ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba// mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag phul// skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badzra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams thun mong gi mnga' dbul brgyad do// zhal zas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin brlabs la/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// mchog tu gyur pa'i zas mchog 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ de bya anne sa manta dhya pra ti ṇa ye swā hā/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /rgyal bas bdud bcom byang chub sangs rgyas te// rgyal ba'i sku la sbrebs skyems mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag bsod nams zhing du 'gyur slad du// bshos dang zhal zas sbyar ba'i 'di phul bas// dus kun dge ba'i lo tog 'phel rgyas nas// bde ba can du padma las skyes te// ting 'dzin chos dang zas la spyod par shog /ces phul/ de nas brtan bzhugs bya ba'i thog mar shis brjod bya ba ni/ thams cad kyi sngar bsgrubs pa'i me tog thogs la/ phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis thog drangs te shis brjod rgyas par byas la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ zhes 'bru 'thor/ thal mo sbyar la/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa las// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs na// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// yon gyi bdag po'i don slad du// bdag gis 'byor pa nyid kyis ni// ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa dang*// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig

/bdag dang slob mar bcas rnams la// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas// kun gyi 'di la byin brlabs shing*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar de srid du/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di la sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing bzhugs su gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rgyas pa la spro na/ bde gshegs kun bzang mthong bas bkra shis ltar// rgyal ba 'khor bcas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas// rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing*// zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa// nyi ltar zhal bro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing*// bdag dang 'gro la zhal dro byin che nas// bskal pa'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol// ji srid me dang chu dang ni// rlung gi bskal pas 'jig bar du// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod// ces dang*/ yig brgya lan bdun bzlas la/ mgon po skal ba ji bzhin du// sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su// de ni 'gro don kun tu mdzod// ces gsol ba btab la brtan bzhugs bya'o// slar yang me tog gi char dbab cing shis brjod sngar ltar bya/ de nas cho ga rgyas pa'i skabs sbyin sreg bya zhing 'o thug bsgrubs nas thams cad la bkye dgos kyang*/ 'dir sa bcad tsam du lha bshos kyi mtha' skor bza' btung cung zad re thams cad la brims te/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// zo zhig sdig pa byang bar gyur// zhes brjod/

de nas chos skyong gtor 'bul dang*/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor bsngos la phrin las bcol/ rgyas pa'i skabs chos skyong dang yon bdag bsgo ba/ rdzas brgyad sbyin pa sogs dgos kyang skabs 'dir spros pa mi mdzad pas dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// rab gnas shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ stegs bu'i khar rnam bum dang las bum/ dri bzang chu dang gos zung sogs khrus chas/ mnga' dbul rdzas/ 'thor nas/ sbyong chas tsam bsham/ bdag bskyed mdor bsdus/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas bum pa sngar ltar bsgrubs nas me tog byin brlab/ sbyong ba bya zhing bgegs bskrad/ khrus gsol spyi 'gre/ rten dam tshig par bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab nas/ ye shes pa gzhug pa nas zhal bsgyur bar sngar ltar bya/ mnga' dbul dang zhal zas phul/ brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod bcas kyis 'grub bo// gsung rab 'bri ba'i yig mkhan rab gnas/ sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rgyu dang lha bzo byin rlabs/ rten rnying po spo ba'i argha'i cho ga sātstsha 'debs pa'i bya ba sogs ni 'dir brir ma longs pa sngar gzhung rnams su shes par bya dgos so// gsum pa gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga'i khungs ni thams cad kyis sbyong rgyud la brten par snang zhing*/ de'ang gsang bde 'jigs gsum lta bu'i dkyil 'khor chen po la sbyor ba'i rgyas pa dang*/ yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed tsam la brten pa'i mdor bsdus pa gnyis yod pa las 'dir phyi ma ltar na/ stegs bu'i steng khrus bum dang las bum gnyis bkod/ phyi mchod gtor 'bul rnams bsham/ khrus chas rnams dang zhi drag gi sbyong ba/ til sbyong gi chas sogs tshogs par bya/ sbyong stegs padma 'dab brgyad steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris pa'i khar gzugs byang ngam ming byang bzhag la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul gyi bar du bya/ khrus bum bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur pa'i nang du steng gi char zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar yig ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsams la rdor sems yig brgya bzla/ mthar zla ba sngags phreng hūm̐ yig rnams 'od du zhu ste bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med par gyur par bsam/ las bum gzhung ltar bsgrub/ de nas ming byang slob dpon gyi mdun du gzhag pa las sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs kyis sbyang*/ rten snang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe 'das kyi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe las 'das pa tha mal pa'i cha byad can phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsams la shi ba 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya mgor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ dzdza/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes ming nas brjod pa'am/

'di nyid kyi rnam par shes pa srid pa bar do khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gang na gnas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba a thung gi gzugs can bkug pa spyi gtsug nas zhugs te snying gar thim par gyur par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'dir spro na sdig pa 'gugs pa dang*/ ltung ba slong ba dang*/ ngan song 'gugs pa dang*/ sdig pa dral zhing 'joms pa'i sngags brgya dmigs pa dang bcas pa bya/ bsdu na mi dgos/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā pā ya bi sho dha ne hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ badzra bandha traṭa/ ces brjod cing snying gar rdo rje bsdams pa sgra dang bcas pa lan gsum dral bas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs par gyur par bsam/ 'dir gnas gsum dang gnas nyer gnyis byin gyis brlab pa sbyong rgyud kyi dgongs par gnas kyang phyag bzhes kha cig tu lhar bskyed pa ltar na/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag bskyed ltar tshe 'das rdor sems su bskyed/ gnas gsum du ye ge gsum bskyed/ de nas sbyong ba ni/ rang khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa sogs mchod bstod kyi bar btang la khro bo spyan drang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// zhes pa/ sdig sbyong chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// zhes dang*/ nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po sgom// zhes pa/ nga ni gnas 'dir tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyang*// zhes par 'don pa bsgyur/ sbyong gtor byin rlabs nas zhi drag sbyong ba rab gnas skabs su bshad pa ltar byas pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyi tshe las 'das pa che ge mo 'di gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/
