tshe 'phos nas gang du gnas pa'i lus srog dang mtho ris dang thar pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad dang*/ tshe las 'das pa'i cha byad bzung nas de'i nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa rnams la bslu zhing gnod par byed pa'i gnod sbyin dang sha za dang 'byung po la sogs pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spongs la/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis sreg cing rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za'o// zhes brjod cing sumbha'i sngags drag tu bzla/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o// til sbyong rgyas pa zhi thab nang dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed bstim mchod bstod bya ba'i tshul yod kyang 'dir bsdus pa'i skabs ram̐ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su skad cig gis khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing zhal gdangs par gyur/ tshe 'das kyi rkang mthil gnyis su rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon pam̐ nag po la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus/ lte ba'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis snying ga'i pam̐ ded nas sna sgo nas thon sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas til nag po la sdig pa'i gzugs byas pa la thim par gyur par bsams te/ mdzub mo dang mthe bo'i dbus su hūm̐ bsams la des sdig pa'i gzugs las bcad nas khro bo'i zhal du phul nas gsol bar mos te/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing mtheb mdzub kyis til me la btab nas bsregs pas sdig pa dag par bsam/

lha mi dmigs par bzhag de nas phyir ldog gi sbyang ba ni/ bye ma'am yungs kar la kaṃ ka ni dang gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang*/ gtsug tor dri med gnyis kyi gzungs dang*/ oṃ padmoṣṇī ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams nyer gcig re/ yi ge brgya pa sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags la mang du bzlas te/ so so'i sngags don dang mthun pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha na badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇā ṇi bha smin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhrūm̐ bi nā sha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ pi sho dha ya ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā pa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni spho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bṛ ta bṛ ta sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tstshinda tstshinda sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga ti he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga ti he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga ti he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba 'di sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang ngan song gsum gyi rgyu las dang*/ nyon mongs pa thams cad las grol te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces pa lta bu'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bzla zhing rten la brabs pas ye shes kyi sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa rten la phogs pas de'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas khrus kyi sbyang ba ni/

dkyil 'khor yod skabs de dang med skabs sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang 'dzoms zhig gi gzugs brnyan me long du shar bar byas te khrus bum thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ sogs/ rgyal pa'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig oṃ sarba nas/ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ de bzhin du sku zhes pa gsung dang thugs/ lus zhes pa ngag dang yid ces par 'don pa bsgyur te khrus gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba nas/ swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug bar bgyi// oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim yid 'ong ba'i// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul// oṃ badzra wa sa sye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas khrus gsol ba'i chu de khrus bum du blugs nas byang bu la 'thor te/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya'o// oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la nas/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/

khyad par du nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig de bzhin du sbyin pa zhes pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab/ ces dang*/ ser sna zhes pa'i gnas su/ tshul 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal/ zhes pa rnams 'don pa bsgyur la tshigs bcad sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas bkru/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// yig brgya/ dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// yig brgya/ dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// yig brgya/ 'jig rten 'di nas zhes pa nas/ khyad par du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun phyogs byang zhing dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// de bzhin du sangs rgyas zhes pa'i gnas su/ bcom ldan dam chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun= zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ 'jig rten 'di nas sogs nas khyad par du nyon mongs pa de'i dbang gis byung ba'i dug thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du sogs brjod/ sa ni dug gi ma yin te// sa ni dug gi pha yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog /dug ni sa yi nang du song*// gang ba'i snod du dug song zhig swā hā/

de bzhin du sa zhes pa'i gnas sa/ chu/ me/ rlung zhes pa bcug la yig brgya spel tshig dang bcas pa bya'o// 'di dag gi bar mtshams su khrus re mdzad pa phyag len du snang ngo*// de nas mi shis pa sbyong ba ni/ dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ gang la ser sna rnams chags pa// sogs nas/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song ba nas/ 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di ngan song gsum las grol nas mtho ris su skyes te bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i shis brjod spel tshig bcas bya/ de nas nye 'brel sogs kyis byang bu thogs par phyag 'tshal du gzhug ste/ tshe 'das de bla ma dang dkyil 'khor pa'i lha dang dkon mchog gsum dang nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro zhing phyag byed par mos te/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje 'dzin zhabs pad la 'dud// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// zhes sogs/ bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// zhes sogs sho lo ka gsum/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la yang bdag phyag 'tshal// dang por me tog phog pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yis thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pa rnam skrag nas// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul pa'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig can bdag la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes brjod/

de nas dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa'i skabs dbang bskur bya dgos la cho ga bsdus pa'i skabs dbang gi bya ba med pas gong du lhar bskyed zin pas 'dir bskyar mi dgos pa dang*/ slar yang gsal gdab par gsungs pa'i phyogs gnyis las phyi ma ltar na/ rten bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra satwa arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// zhes bstod/ 'dir 'dul 'dzin rjes tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba'i mdo'i dgongs don ltar tshe 'das la zas gtad bya ba mi bzhed cing*/ gshin po'i ched du dkon mchog la bza' btung gos sogs phul zhing de'i dge ba gshin po la bsngo bar gsungs pa ltar yang legs mod/ yul lugs kun la zas bsngo grags che zhing bar do'i sems dris tshim par bshad pa ltar bza' btung gsur bsngo byas pa la'ang dgos pa che bar snang bas de ltar na 'dod yon rnams bshams la bsang sbyang*/ zas gtad kyi yo byad rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i zhal zas ro brgya pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' mdzod ltar longs spyad pas zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/

phud kyis dkon mchog la sngags dang phyag rgya bcas mchod cing bstod/ lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du rū pa'i gnas su shabda/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe 'jug phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin dang*// yon tan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes shing= phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= bzhes shing= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes shing= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos= bzhes shing= zhes sogs brjod cing 'dod yon lnga dbul/ de las lam sbyang bstan la/ shes shing spro na/ bde can zhing dang 'od dpag med kyi yon tan brjod cing rnam pa gsal gdab tu gzhug lam sbyong ba dang bstan pa'i don brda sprad/ mi nus na/ slob dpon gyis don dran par byas la/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas// 'phags pa'i lam der bgrod par shog /oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne/ ratna saṃ bha we/ ratna ki ra ṇe/ ratna mā la bi shuddhe/ shodha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas lam bstan la/ padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i padmo las byung ba// bde ba can du skye bar shog

/oṃ padme padme padma saṃ bha be/ ma hā su kha ba ti gatstshantu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ lam sbyangs pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes lha ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres pa spyi gtsug nas thon te bde ba can du gshegs pa der padma las brdzus te skyes/ de na gnas pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra satku ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes pa des kyang sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas swā hā/ zhes mchod nas gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa thob par gyur/ de'i tshe lha rnams kyis tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes pa sogs cho ga byed pa po bdag gi mthur shes nas rang nyid la/ oṃ sarba nas swā hā/ zhes mchod cing*/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med// chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med// dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med de// sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med// ces ched du brjod par gyur/ tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes pa des kyang rang nyid der skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas bdag gis cho ga byas pa'i nus mthur shes nas skad cig gis 'ongs te/ e ma shākya mgon po yi// sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che// gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi// sems can glog bzhin myur du grol// de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid bsam mi khyab// sngags kyi yon tan sna tshogs bsam mi khyab// byang chub rten pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab// tshangs spyod tshul khrims dri med skye bsam yas// e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che// gang phyir mtshams med lhung ba yi// sems can lhag nas myur du skyes// zhes ched du brjod nas bdag dang lha la/ oṃ sarba nas swā hā/ zhes mchod de slar yang bde ba can du song bar gyur par bsam/

oṃ sarba buddha kṣe tra gatstshantu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ de'ang tshe 'das bde ba can du sleb pa'i skyos ma lta bur rin po che'i rang bzhin bde ba can du 'thor ba'i mos pa byas te 'thor gsungs so// de nas byang bu bsreg pa ni/ lha dang rnam shes gshegs pa'i phung po lhag ma sdig sgrib dang lhan cig ram̐ las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi mes bsregs par gyur par bsams la/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro// 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la// lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro// dbang po drug gi bud shing la// byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro// yul rnams drug gi bud shing la// lha mo drug ni me sbar ro// lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la// rgyal ba sku gsum me sbar ro// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /ces brjod cing me la bsreg stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ ces pa nas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes pa'i bar don dran bzhin pas brjod cing phung po lnga'i dri ma nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma'i bar bag chags dang bcas pa zab gsal gnyis med mthar thug mer shar ba'i ye shes kyi mer bsregs pas/ phung po lnga rnam par dag pa rigs lnga nas lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bar yongs su rdzogs pa'i thob bya mthar thug thob par bsams la byang thal gyis sātstsha gdab pa sogs spyi ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na rjes chog dgos kyang bdag bskyed rkyang pa tsam la nyer bsdu/ rgyun spyod bsngo smon byas pas 'grub bo// ༈ /bzhi pa sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rnams nang gses kyi khyad par dbye ba las spyi'i 'gros mtshungs pas 'dir nye bar mkho ba zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul ni/

sa'i cho ga sngon du ma byas pa'i gzhi las sbyong ba dgos pas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom zhing*/ rdo rje gsum gyis sa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par bsam pa'am/ yang na rang gi lha'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas kyang rung ste/ de 'dra ba'i kun rdzob kyi dag pa dang*/ sa'i skyon thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong par gyur pa bsgom pa don dam pa'i sbyang ba bya/ thab stegs gzhi dkar po gru bzhi pa'i khar bris thab la tshangs zur gyi thig gdab/ rgyar khru gang pa/ mchu dang kha khyer la sor bzhi re/ nang du cha phran gcig pa'i rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i lte bar padma 'dab brgyad lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje re re bri/ thams cad kha dog dkar po 'ba' zhig byas pa la ba byung lnga bdud rtsi lnga dri bzang rnams kyis byug me tog dkar po sil ma dgram/ zlum skor nang ma'i steng nas tsher ma sogs dri mi zhim pa dang*/ srog chags med pa'i shing skam po zlum por brtsig slob dpon gyi g.yon phyogs thab dang nye bar stegs bu'i steng 'dus pa'i lugs byed na chu bzhi/ bzed zhal gsum/ bsang gtor ku sha'i chun po dang bcas pa/ las bum rnams bkod/ g.yas kyi stegs bur bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bsgrig de'i nang rol tu 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i mchod rdzas mthar gtor 'bul dkar zlum bsham/ de'i nang rol 'jig rten 'das pa'i mchod rdzas nyer spyod lnga po dgod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril dgang blugs mar khu bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod rnams bzhag me gso ba'i rdzas dang ku sha'i chun po brgyad rnams sta gon bya/ de la yam shing dri zhim tsher ma med pa 'o ma can gyi shing srid du sor bcu gnyis sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad ma gas pa rtse mo gnyis mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa/

til dūrba/ 'bras ma grugs pa/ zho zan/ ku sha/ yungs kar/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro rnams bsreg rdzas gtso bo yin la/ zho 'o ma 'bras zan tsandan pri yaṃ ku thang chu dri zhim po'i me tog rnams kyang 'dzom na 'bul bar gsung ngo*// slob dpon chas gos dkar po dang dung shel la sogs pas brgyan cing padma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi gdan la kha shar du phyogs pas padma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod do// de nas thog mar bdag bskyed bzlas pa nyer bsdu'i bar tshang bar bya/ las bum bsgrub/ sbyin sreg dngos kyi thog mar sngags phyag rgya rgyas bsdus gang rung gis rdor dril bzung la dam tshig gsum dran cing cho ga ma tshar bar rdor dril ma bral ba dang smra ba bcad/ lag pa g.yas pas las bum gyi chu blangs la rang dang thab mchod rdzas rnams la g.yon ngos nas brtsams g.yas skor du 'thor/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod de bzhin du 'thor/ slar me lha'i mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod 'thor la/ bsang sbyang*/ sgrub thabs ltar byin brlab/ de nas lag gnyis rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas bsreg rdzas rnams la reg cing*/ oṃ swā hā zhes pas bkrus par bsams nas/ oṃ āḥswā hās yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrī swā hās zhun mar dang*/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hās 'bru dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās de dag las gzhan pa'i/ rdzas rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs shing dag nas bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas 'o ma can las byung ba'i shing gi me sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod de snod du bzhag la/ zhun mar gyi sgron me sbar zhing*/ las sngags brjod la/ bsang chu dang nang mchod kyis me de la g.yas skor du lan gsum gsum bsang*/ sgron me de rtswa skam po'i chun po dang bcas thab kyi nang du bcug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod de gzi brjid bskyed/ hūm̐ zhes brjod de rlung yab kyis me sbar/

las sngags lan bdun brjod pa/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis kyang me gso// de nas ku sha rnams lag tu bzung la/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod la ku sha byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod nas ku sha'i chun po gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs pa rang gi g.yon ngos nas brtsams te/ thab kyi kha khyer la/ rang gar la kha bltas pa ngos la shar du byas pa'i lugs kyi rtse mo shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du bstan la snga ma'i rtse mos phyi ma'i rtsa ba non par dgram zhing*/ thab khung du rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang yang mi ring bas g.yog go /de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'/ bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab ste de dag ni sbyor ba'o// dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ thog mar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ bsang chus thab bsangs la/ las sngags kyis bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ thab stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa/ mu ran dang kha khyer dang bcas pa/ kha khyer la/

'khor lo'am rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ thab kyi nang du ram̐ las skyes pa'i me gru gsum gyi dbus su sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i lte bar ram̐ las bgrang phreng*/ de yongs su gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i rang 'od kyi rig ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sku/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang gi rig ma la 'khyud cing lhag ma g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyu gu dang ril ba 'dzin pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ smin ma dang ral pa'i tshogs 'bar zhing lto ba 'phyang ba/ sbom zhing thung la gzi brjid che ba g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar me gru gsum pa ram̐ mam/ yang na hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ dam tshig pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las spros pa'i khro bo 'dod rgyal gyis shar lho nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i me lha drang srong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong g.yob cing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ thab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer gyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsang chu gtor nas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ gsang 'dus la chu bzhi 'bul dgos kyang 'dir chu 'bul bas 'thus/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ prokṣa ṇāṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas ku sha'i chun pos zhal bsil gyi snod nas bzed zhal dang por lan gsum bsang gtor dbul lo// snod de nyid nas mdzub mo me tog blangs te/

khu tshur kha 'og tu bstan nas mthe'u chung nas rim gyi dgrol ba'i phyag rgya dang sngar gyi prokṣa ṇāṃ gyi gnas su āñtsa mā ṇā zhes bzed zhal dang por zhabs bsil dang*/ rdo rje snyim pa kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ arghaṃ zhes sbyar ba'i bzed zhal gnyis par mchod yon dang*/ khu tshur bcangs te chu nang nas me tog blangs la/ lan gsum bskor te khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i mdzub mo nas rim gyis dgrol ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ pā dyaṃ zhes sbyar bas bzed zhal gsum par zhabs bsil dbul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye ā di byā ā di byā ā bi she ā bi she ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bā hā nā ya badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ bā hā nā ya badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ agna ye zhes pa nas/ bā hā nā ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nyer spyod lnga dang*/ nang mchod dbul/ dril stabs dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i thig pa bcibs// rig sngags gsung zhing bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghaṇḍe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la dzwa la ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣṭan hūm̐ phaṭa dṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig bsgrag go /de nas me lha'i ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po la ram̐ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yas g.yon de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gyis dgang blugs bzung la mar khu blangs te byang chub phyag rgyas pus mo'i nang nas phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor te/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par dgang blugs gsum mam bdun 'bul te/ de la dang po me lha'i sngags/ oṃ agna ye ā di byā ā bi she ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā hā nā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa dang*/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ gnyis pa dgang blugs kyi sngags ni/ oṃ na maḥs manta buddha nān agna ye swā hā/ zhes pa la spel tshig sbyar ba'o// gsum pa bsreg rdzas sngags ni/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes pa la spel tshig sbyar ba'o// skabs 'dir me la bgegs yod med brtag nas/ yod na sel ba'i thabs spyi ltar bya'o// de nas yam shing g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis mchog sbyin phyag rgyas rtse mo lha la bstan nas dbul zhing*/ yam shing rnams byang chub shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ agna ye ā di byā ā di byā ā bi she ā bi she ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā hā nā ya/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya/ bdag cag dpon slob ces pa nas/ bkra mi shis pa dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu la/ oṃ agna ye zhes pa nas bā hā nā ya/ oṃ agna ye/ bdag cag dpon slob ces pa nas/ bkra mi shis pa dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la sogs gsham snga mas 'gre/

til la me lha'i sngags sngar gyi mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya/ bdag cag nas/ sdig pa thams cad/ de nas dūrba gnyis gnyis sbyar nas dbul zhing*/ sngags mthar/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe/ bdag cag nas/ tshe mthar phyin pa la bar du= 'bras ma grugs pa la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya/ bdag cag= bsod nams rgyas pa la= zho zan la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de/ bdag cag= bde ba mchog la= ku sha gnyis gnyis sbyar la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya/ bdag cag= srung ba mchog la bar du gcod pa dang grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad= yungs kar la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ sarba artha siddhā ya/ bdag cag bgegs thams cad= so ba la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya/ bdag cag= nor dang 'bru rgyas par/ nas la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ ma ha be gā ya/ bdag cag myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la/ sran ma la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ya/ bdag cag= stobs rgyas pa la= gro la/ sngags mthar/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī/ bdag cag= nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas bsreg rdzas gzhan yod na me lha'i sngags kyis phul/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ āñtsa mā ṇāṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pas zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satka raṃ prokṣa ṇāṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā zhes pas bsang gtor dbul lo// de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ thog mar lha bskyed pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na me lha'i thugs kar gzhal yas khang dang gdan bskyed/ las rdor gyis tshom bu spyan drang*/ slob dpon gyis thab tu dor la/ lha gsal btab nas mchod bstod 'bul dgos la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs/ me lha'i thugs kar mngon rtogs ltar lha bskyed/ sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar dmigs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs 'dod yon lnga phul nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ye shes pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ 'dod yon/ nang mchod rnams 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ ces brjod cing dmigs nas/ yig brgya'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob ces pa nas/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs bdun phul nas gsol ba btab pas phrin las mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo// de nas bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba la grub na lha'i sngags dang bsreg rdzas kyi sngags dang spel tshig gsum ga sbyar ba dang*/ bsreg rdzas re re mnyam du 'bul/ de ltar ma grub na bsreg rdzas dang po la gsum ga sbyar/ de man chad la lha'i sngags re re dang spel tshig re re nas sbyar la dbul/ de ma grub na bdun bdun gyi mthar lan re sbyar ba dang*/ de yang ma grub na thog mtha' gnyis su lha'i sngags/ bsreg rdzas kyi sngags/ spel tshig gsum gar sbyar ba re/ gzhan rnams lha'i sngags re dang bsreg rdzas re dus mtshungs su byas nas dbul/ bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo yam shing dang*/ zhun mar 'bul thengs re dang sngags re sbyar ba sbyin sreg re re'i grangs su brtsi ba yin/ yam shing dang mar gtso bo yin pas mang ba dang*/ gzhan rnams de las nyung ba dang*/ sdig pa zhi ba dgos pa gtso bo yin na til mang ba dbul zhing*/ tshe'i bar chad zhi ba don du gnyer na dūrba mang bar dbul ba sogs shes par bya ste/ bod dag gis grangs nges mang po byed pa ni snying po med pa'i rtog bzo 'ba' zhig yin gsungs/

de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul tshar ba dang*/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas bsgrub bya zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la khrus byas pas sdig sgrib dang nad gdon la sogs pa dag nas lus shel ltar gyur par bsam/ de nas mar dgang blugs gsum mam bdun la sogs pa gtso bo'i sngags kyi dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā re zhes sogs kyis mchod yon bsang gtor zhabs bsil gsum dbul/ oṃ badzra wa sa sya swā hā zhes pas gos gsar pa me nang du dbul zhing lha la na bza' dbul bar bsam/ oṃ badzra tambu la swā hā/ zhes pas so rtsi dbul/ de nas nyer spyod dang 'dod yon tshigs bcad dang bcas pas rgyas par 'bul/ oṃ badzra satwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa dang phyag byas nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ de nas lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i don du me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad rigs// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs// oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes mang du brjod nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa bzla bar bya'o// de'i rjes la/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags// ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal// sems can kun la ci 'dod par// dngos grub bla na med pa stsal// slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir// rang gi gnas gshegs badzra muḥ tshom bu spyan 'dren skabs lha rnams me lha'i thugs ka nas slar gshegs te dkyil 'khor pa la thim par mos te tshom bu slar spyan drang*/

sreg rkyang skabs/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par mos la/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsams la pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bya'o// de nas thab kyi me lha la/ oṃ agna ye/ zhes pa nas/ bā hā nā ya puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ bā hā nā ya shabda pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ bā hā nā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nyer spyod lnga dang nang mchod dbul/ de nas bsang gtor zhal bsil so rtsi gos gsar pa rnams dbul/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams 'jig rten pa'i me lha la sngar bzhin 'bul/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas yang zhal bsil dang bsang gtor phul la/ me lha'i sngags la/ puṣpe sogs sbyar bas kyang mchod/ de nas gtor ma chang chu nang mchod kyis sbyangs te/ oṃ āḥbighna na ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ shū n+ya tā zhes pa nas/ ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa bdun gyi bar gyis sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlab/ oṃ agna ye zhes pa nas/ bā hā nā ya a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ adya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa gsum gyi gtor ma dbul/ me lha'i sngags kyi mthar/ puṣpaṃ sogs sbyar bas sngar ltar nyer spyod lnga dbul/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas pas/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// zhes pa nas/ de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur spyon zhing*// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ āḥbadzra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ cho ga rgyas pa'i skabs 'o thug sgrub pa skabs 'dir byas la bsngo smon dang shis pa brjod pa bcas kyi grub bo// rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg kha bsgyur sogs sbyin sreg spyi 'gros la mkhas pa dag gis cho ga 'di la rigs 'gres pas chog go /'di ni mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus sbyin sreg gi cho ga ltar bkod pa'o// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpa' bo gcig pa la// brten nas bsnyen sgrub las rim brtsam pa'i tshul// go bder bkod 'dis bka' srol 'di yi lugs// phyogs mthong tsam gyi blo mig 'thob gyur cig /tshul 'di rje bla ma thams cad gzigs pa nyid kyis tho byang rtsa ba tsam bkod nas dgongs pas rjes su gnang ba ltar gang gi dgongs pa skong ba'i slad du thub bstan ris med la dad cing gus pa'i yid can 'du gsum pa yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
